15/S0.subgoal: Categorize the different types of AR hardware and their common application areas.

15/S1.subgoal: Describe the characteristics and components of AR headsets.

15/S2.subgoal: Explain the characteristics and operation of smart glasses and handheld AR devices.

15/S3.subgoal: Describe the fundamental principles and defining features of spatial AR systems.

15/S4.subgoal: Explain interactive projectors and sandboxes as examples of spatial AR.

15/S5.subgoal: Describe projection keyboards and projection mapping as spatial AR techniques.

15/S6.subgoal: Explain specialized and emerging AR technologies including HUDs and contact lenses.

15/S7.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
